import java.util.*;
public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.next();
        System.out.println(countEvenRuns(str, 0));
    }
    static int countEvenRuns(String s, int idx) {
        if (idx >= s.length()) return 0;
        int end = idx;
        while (end < s.length() && s.charAt(end) == s.charAt(idx)) end++;
        int runLen = end - idx;
        int add = (runLen % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        return add + countEvenRuns(s, end);
    }
}
